subject: Temporary commercial incentive - sequencing regression impact
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T08:50:00-07:00
Subject: Temporary commercial incentive - sequencing regression impact

Team,

Heads-up: SparkLens (pilot) reported a regression in our long-sequence path yesterday that increased P95 tail latency for their streaming ingestion by ~25-30%. They paused some onboarding flows and want a commercial accommodation while we push the fix and validate performance.

Sales ask (customer-facing): a timeboxed invoice credit applied to June billing up to a cap. Proposed structure in the attached note: a usage-tied credit (not cash) with a 30-day telemetry-sharing requirement and a 14-day remediation window after the runtime patch is deployed. Cap proposed: $45k.

Why this matters: pilot conversion probability drops quickly if they lose confidence. SparkLens is strategic in the vertical and high ARR potential if they convert. I want a quick decision on exec-level flexibility and any policy language we must include.

Key constraints to consider:
- We must avoid open-ended concessions.
- Finance needs a GL and fallback if the remediation doesn't land.
- Legal needs short turnaround on the terms.

Request: please confirm delegation threshold we can use (cap), whether credits must be invoice-only, and any standard rollback language. If approved, I'll send the draft to Olivia + procurement this afternoon.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: commercial_note_v1.pdf, sparklens_q2_usage.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary commercial incentive - sequencing regression impact

Tessa -

Thanks for flagging and for the attachments. From Field Sales and CS: I support a timeboxed invoice credit to preserve pilot momentum. A few suggested edits so we don't set a lasting precedent:
1) Increase cap to $50k (to avoid reopening if usage spikes) but make explicit that credits are invoice-only and non-transferable.
2) Require a verification checklist (logs + P95 telemetry for three production runs post-fix) before any credit is applied.
3) Include an explicit de-escalation clause if remediation isn't validated within 14 calendar days post-deploy.

If Finance can sign off on $50k we can move fast. I'll draft the customer language and loop in Legal for a 24-48hr review.

-Karthik
Head of Field Sales

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary commercial incentive - sequencing regression impact

Tessa / Karthik -

Operational notes from Sales Ops: if Finance approves, we need the credit to hit a specific revenue code and be tagged to the deal so it doesn't affect quota calculations incorrectly. Also recommend limiting the window to one invoice cycle.

Action items for approvals:
- Aditya: confirm delegation and whether $50k is within threshold (or we need exec sign-off).
- Legal: quick clause review for telemetry and rollback language.
- Engineering: confirm remediation ETA and who owns validation (devops contact).

I'll stand by to apply the code and create the deal note once we have Aditya's confirmation.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary commercial incentive - sequencing regression impact

Team -

I reviewed the usage extract and the commercial note. Finance can approve a timeboxed invoice credit up to $45,000 under my delegation if the credit meets these conditions:
1) Credit is applied as an invoice line-item only (no refunds).
2) Credit cap $45,000; if Sales wants higher we need CFO sign-off.
3) The customer signs the acceptance of telemetry sharing and the rollback clause (14 days).
4) We tag the credit to GL 6721 and include a repayment clause if remediation is not adopted within 30 days.

If that works, Karthik/Tessa, proceed with customer language and Legal. I'll expedite the finance entry once the signed acknowledgement is received.

-Aditya Rao
Director, Finance

From: Olivia Ramos <olivia.ramos@sparklens.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sparklens.ai
Date: 2028-06-21T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary commercial incentive - sequencing regression impact

Tessa -

Appreciate the fast coordination. We can accept a timeboxed invoice credit under the conditions Aditya listed. A couple quick clarifications before procurement signs:
- Please confirm the exact verification steps (we need the list to share with our COO).
- Confirm credits are line-item offsets and will appear on the July invoice.

If you can send the one-page acknowledgement with the telemetry sharing checkbox we will route it through procurement and return signed by EOD tomorrow. Happy to hop on a 20m call if useful.

Thanks,
Olivia Ramos
Head of Growth, SparkLens
